title: Character conversion of a container: FROMCCSID / INTOCCSID (037 and 1208), DATATYPE(CHAR), INTOCCSID and FROMCCSID on a BIT container

scenarios.summary: CACCSID puts CHAR containers as CCSID 037, as 1208 and with DATATYPE(CHAR) alone, and gets each with INTOCCSID 1208, 037 and none: the bytes come back in the CCSID asked for, the region's (037) by default; INTOCCSID with no channel is INVREQ
CACCBIT puts a BIT container and gets it with INTOCCSID (CCSIDERR RESP2 3, bytes unconverted) and without (NORMAL); a PUT of a BIT container with FROMCCSID is INVREQ RESP2 34
